source_metadata.title: A Systematic Review and Network Meta-Analysis of Pharmacological Treatment of Heart Failure With Reduced Ejection Fraction
source_metadata.source_type: systematic review and frequentist component network meta-analysis

atoms.canonical_statement: The review sought to estimate and compare the aggregate treatment benefit of pharmacological therapy for HFrEF.

source_anchor.verbatim_excerpt: estimate and compare the aggregate treatment benefit of pharmacological therapy for heart failure

atoms.canonical_statement: The study used a frequentist additive component network meta-analysis of randomized trials, with fixed or random effects selected according to heterogeneity.

source_anchor.verbatim_excerpt: an additive component network meta-analysis model can be used to evaluate the influence of individual components

atoms.canonical_statement: Background therapy was assigned to a treatment combination when at least 50% of participants received that therapy.

source_anchor.verbatim_excerpt: We considered patients on background therapy if 50% of patients were on therapy.

atoms.canonical_statement: Eligible studies were randomized trials in adults with HFrEF treated as outpatients or after stabilization; acute-HF studies, major disease-specific populations, and within-class drug comparisons were excluded.

source_anchor.verbatim_excerpt: Target studies were limited to adult populations

population.label: Adults with HFrEF
inclusion_criteria: outpatient or stabilized after HF hospitalization
exclusion_criteria: entire cohort with major concomitant diagnosis affecting outcome

atoms.canonical_statement: All-cause death was the primary outcome; secondary analyses included CV death plus HF hospitalization, CV death, and treatment discontinuation.

source_anchor.verbatim_excerpt: We focused on all-cause death as the primary outcome of interest

atoms.canonical_statement: The review included 75 trials with 95,444 participants, 23% women, and 199,978 participant-years of follow-up; median follow-up was 11 months.

source_anchor.verbatim_excerpt: these studies included 95,444 patients (23% women), and 199,978 participant years of follow-up

population.label: Adults with HFrEF across 75 included randomized trials

atoms.canonical_statement: Overall risk of bias was reported as low; most included studies were multicenter, double-blind, placebo-controlled trials, with the highest risk in four non-double-blind studies.

source_anchor.verbatim_excerpt: overall risk of bias was low

atoms.canonical_statement: No systematic reporting bias was detected for all-cause mortality (Egger P=0.122).

atoms.canonical_statement: Compared with actual care, comprehensive ARNi + beta-blocker + MRA + SGLT2 inhibitor therapy was estimated to add 4.9 life-years at age 50 (95% CI 1.4-8.4).

atoms.canonical_statement: Compared with actual care, comprehensive ARNi + beta-blocker + MRA + SGLT2 inhibitor therapy was estimated to add 3.3 life-years at age 70 (95% CI 0.7-5.8).

atoms.canonical_statement: Compared with no treatment, the main text estimated 7.9 life-years gained at age 50 with ARNi + beta-blocker + MRA + SGLT2 inhibitor (95% CI 4.7-11.2).

atoms.canonical_statement: Sensitivity analyses using ACE inhibitor rather than ARNi background therapy for newer trials, excluding hydralazine/digoxin, and restricting to trials with at least 100 events produced similar conclusions.

source_anchor.verbatim_excerpt: results remained similar when excluding hydralazine/nitrates and digoxin

atoms.canonical_statement: The network could not estimate vericiguat or omecamtiv mecarbil on top of SGLT2 inhibitor therapy.

source_anchor.verbatim_excerpt: we were not able to assess the aggregate treatment effect of vericiguat or omecamtiv-mecarbil on top of SGLT2i

atoms.canonical_statement: ARNi exposure in recent trials was below 50%, requiring background-therapy assumptions and sensitivity analyses.

source_anchor.verbatim_excerpt: ARNi was used by fewer than 50% of the populations in the recent trials

atoms.canonical_statement: The network meta-analysis did not account for differences in drug dosages.

source_anchor.verbatim_excerpt: We did not account for differences in drug dosages in our NMA.

atoms.canonical_statement: Life-year projections assumed that treatment adherence persisted over time.

source_anchor.verbatim_excerpt: assume that adherence to treatment persists over time

atoms.canonical_statement: The long time span across heart-failure trials could have introduced bias.

source_anchor.verbatim_excerpt: The timespan over which different HF trials have been performed is substantial, which might have introduced bias.

atoms.canonical_statement: The discontinuation results were limited by substantial heterogeneity and should be interpreted cautiously.

source_anchor.verbatim_excerpt: The results for discontinuation showed considerable heterogeneity

atoms.canonical_statement: Nonpharmacological device use was not incorporated into treatment-benefit estimates.

source_anchor.verbatim_excerpt: we did not take nonpharmacological device use into account

atoms.canonical_statement: The authors concluded that the comprehensive network meta-analysis supports ARNi + beta-blocker + MRA + SGLT2 inhibitor therapy for HFrEF and that expected life-years gained are considerable.

source_anchor.verbatim_excerpt: support treatment of patients with HFrEF with a combination of ARNi, BB, MRA, and SGLT2i
